definition.description: Each of the 19 nodes (x, y, z, 0‑9a‑f) is a primitive that can be assigned a semantic label and definition per Factor.

state_definition.applicability: States apply only to explicit nodes. Implicit nodes (x,y,z) are always in state 0 (eternal context).

constraint: The set of node IDs is invariant. Their semantic meaning is Factor‑specific and stored in the Factor's semantic mapping.
